It is said that Bungee was originally a grown-up ceremony of the indigenous people of New Guinea . People stood on branches of the tree , which was over 30 meters high . Their feet were fastened with canes and they jumped off from where they stood . When they almost reached the ground , they suddenly stopped to prove their bravery and express that they were able to endure the hardships of life independently .	据说蹦极最初是新几内亚土著人的一种成人仪式。人们站在30多米高的树枝上。他们的脚被拐杖捆着，从站立的地方跳了下来。当他们几乎到达地面时，他们突然停下来证明自己的勇敢，并表示自己能够独立地忍受生活的艰辛。

In 1986 , a New Zealander Hackett popularized Bungee as a commercialized sport of mass entertainment . This sport is very challenging . It is a test of people's psychological ability of endurance . Especially when descending , as if they are watching a fast forward tape and when they bounce back , they sway around . The timid people will shrink back at the sight of it . Even if they jump off , they find it hard to avoid screaming with closed eyes . No wonder people give the title ' brave ' to anyone who jumps off .	1986年，一位新西兰人哈克特将蹦极作为一项大众娱乐的商业化运动加以推广。这项运动很有挑战性，是对人们心理承受能力的考验。尤其是在下降时，好像蹦极的人在看快进磁带一样，反弹时他们会左右摇摆。胆小的人一看就会怕。就算他们敢跳下来，也很难免会闭上眼睛尖叫。难怪人们都说蹦极的人很勇敢。
You see , the bungee participants take a deep breath when they stand at the starting spot and then , like diving , their heads are over heels and they jump off into the realm of the combination of heaven and earth . The wind roars at their ears and their bodies rapidly descend . They do not even have enough time to do several gymnastic movements and they are rebounded to the upper air by the cord .	你看，蹦极选手站在起跑点深吸一口气，然后像跳水一样，头朝下脚朝上，纵身一跃融入天地合一的境界，风在耳边呼啸，身体急速下降。还没来得及做几个体操动作，就被绳子反弹到高空。
Entrusting life to the care of a rope indeed requires infinite courage .	把生命托付给一根绳子确实需要莫大的勇气。
A young French fellow recalled his first bungee experience and said , " When I fastened the cord and walked to the platform , I was extremely nervous . When I looked down , I was nervous even more . If the cord had broken , I would be knocked to ' bakemeat ' . However , I knew my worries were unwanted . I was afraid if I retreated others might say something about me . I had to harden my heart and impose my head downward . I only felt wind wiring at my ears . My body rapidly descended . I thought that after only seven or eight seconds I was rebounded to upper air by the cord . In fact it was 30 seconds . Maybe because of my nervousness , I only felt seven or eight seconds . When rebounding to the high altitude , I felt a sudden sense of relief . I did not feel nervous very much , but very comfortable . "	一个法国小伙子回忆起他第一次蹦极的经历，他说，当我系好绳子走向跳台时，我非常紧张。我往下看的时候更紧张，如果绳子断了，我就完蛋了。但我知道我的担心是多余的。我怕自己退后别人会说我。所以只能一狠心，把头向下压。我只觉得耳边有风。我的身体迅速下降。我以为只过了七八秒我就被绳子弹到了高空。其实是30秒。可能是因为紧张，我只感觉到七八秒钟。当反弹到高空时，我突然有一种解脱的感觉。我不觉得紧张，反而很舒服。
It is hard to come by in life that you experience this kind of ' comfortable '	人生难得几回这样的“舒服”啊！

Are they designed differently ?	它们的设计不同吗？
A road bike features skinny tires and a light-weight frame . Its riding position puts you bent over the handlebars . It's not particularly beefy in construction , and generally , it won't stand up well under heavy loads or on really rough surfaces . In contrast , mountain bikes have wide tires and a stout frame . You sit higher on them and don't have to hunched over .	公路自行车的特点是轮胎很薄，车架很轻。你得俯身在车把上骑行。它在行驶中不是特别稳定，一般来说，它在沉重的负载下或在非常粗糙的表面上不能很好地直立。相比之下，山地车有宽大的轮胎和粗壮的车架。你能坐得高一点，不必弯腰驼背。

You got it ! In a sense , it has become a byword for Chinese sport .	确实是这样！从某种意义上说，它已经成为中国体育的代名词。
What do you think might be the source of its popularity ?	你认为它受欢迎的原因是什么？
I think its critical advantage lies in its low cost . All you need is a racket , a table and a light celluloid ball . Tables are usually available in public recreation areas , like finest rooms , and outdoor playgrounds ...	我认为它的主要优势在于成本低。你只需要一个球拍，一张桌子和一个轻塑料球。公共娱乐区有很多桌子，娱乐室和室外操场都有……
And sometimes a substitute table can be made out of a few desks .	有时可以用几张桌子拼成一张替代桌。
Put it there ! In senior high schools , we used to play on desks in the classroom , when no vacant tables were available . Likewise , the racket may take a variety of forms , too.Anything that resembles a racket , from a plank to cardboard or even a hardcover book , may be used as a racket .	说的太对了！在高中，我们常常在教室里的课桌上打球，那时没有空桌子。同样，球拍也可以有多种形式，任何类似球拍的东西，从木板到硬纸板，甚至精装书，都可以作为球拍使用。

You mean , kung fu may not be so powerful as it is imagined ? To some extent your idea holds water . Kung fu was originally intended for self-defense , but with time it became something more than defense skills . Now we are apt to treat it as an art .	你的意思是，功夫可能没有想象中那么强大？在某种程度上，你的想法是有道理的。功夫最初是为了自卫，但随着时间的推移，它已不仅仅是防御技能。现在我们倾向于把它当作一门艺术。

Some practices even appear somewhat awkward or rude to Westerners , while they are the norm in China . Hey , your chopsticks , old silly ! In China at least , coffee is often associated with an exotic , well-to-do bourgeois lifestyle . Coffee is often considered a hobby of the well-educated , middle-class people .	至少是在中国，咖啡常常与富有异国情调的中产阶级生活方式联系在一起。咖啡通常被认为是那些受过良好教育的中产阶级的爱好。
Maybe that's why some young chaps often spend a whole afternoon in a coffee bar , surfing the net or just typewriting something with laptop . While they are savoring a coffee at a leisured pace , they are actually showing off !	所以有些年轻人经常花一个下午，泡在咖啡馆上网或者只是用笔记本打字。当他们悠闲地品尝咖啡的时候，其实是在炫耀！
Yes . Behind a lifestyle , there is a culture . Young people easily become blind worshippers of a Westernized life . While they may not really like coffee , they think it desirable and enviable to be lavish with money in those high-consumption places .	嗯嗯，在一种生活方式的背后，有一种文化。年轻人很容易对西化的生活产生盲目崇拜。虽然他们可能并不是真的喜欢喝咖啡，但他们认为在那些高消费场所挥霍金钱很有面子、很令人羡慕。
Then what about tea ? We need to bear in mind in the first place that tea , rather than coffee , has been the most popular drink for the Chinese people .	那喝茶呢？我们首先要记住，中国人最喜欢的饮料是茶，而不是咖啡。
Well . Tea represents another facet of popular culture . While a coffee bar is usually quiet and resonates with soft , elegant music , a teahouse is often a noisy , crowded , public space . People visit teahouses to associate with others , playing chess , chatting , or simply listening to operas .	茶代表了流行文化的另一个方面。咖啡馆通常是安静的，伴随着柔和优雅的音乐，而茶馆通常是嘈杂、拥挤的公共空间。人们去茶馆与人交往，下棋，聊天，或者听听歌剧。
What a pity that the traditional teahouses , as depicted by Lao She , keep fading away so quickly in this metropolis . It is not easy to find an old-fashioned teahouse that suits the ordinary people's spending power either . Teahouses of today all feature a cozy , comfortable environment , and high-quality services , but can easily cost you a good deal — just like a coffee bar .	老舍笔下的传统茶馆，在这座大都市里，消失得如此迅速，真是可惜。要找到一个适合普通人消费能力的老式茶馆也不容易。现在的茶馆都有舒适的环境和优质的服务，但随便就会花掉你很多钱-就像咖啡馆一样了。

Does tea-serving follow any special etiquette in China ? Each time I dropped in at my Chinese friends ' homes , their parents would offer me a cup of hot , strong tea , though they never inquired of me about whether I want it .	在中国端茶有什么特别的礼仪吗？每次我去中国朋友家，他们父母都会给我一杯热腾腾的浓茶，尽管他们从不问我想不想喝。
You've got a point there . It is a custom and good manners to serve tea to a guest who comes to pay a visit . There is no need to ask if he needs it or not , or if he wants something else . It might be an insult to the guest if he is left sitting there without being served tea .	你说得有道理。给来访的客人端茶是一种风俗和良好的礼仪。没有必要问需不需要，或者他是否想要别的东西。如果让客人坐在那里不喝茶，可能是对他主人的侮辱。
So the guest is presumed to be thirsty and in need of some drink after the trip . In that case , I guess , in return , the guest doesn't have to drink it if he wouldn't like it .	因此，客人过来一趟，可能会很渴需要喝点东西。那样的话，我猜，反过来，客人不喜欢就不用喝了。
It wouldn't be considered rude behavior if he doesn't even take a single drop . But he'd better receive the teacup with both hands and bow his thanks when the cup is brought before his face . When the host pours hot water into his cup , he may also choose to tap his index finger on the table , meaning " Thanks " . No matter if he likes it or not , it is impolite if he doesn't even lay a finger on the cup .	如果他连一滴都不喝就不会被认为是粗鲁的行为。但他最好双手接过茶杯，当茶杯递到他面前时鞠躬致谢。当主人往杯子里倒热水时，他也可以选择用食指轻拍桌子，意思是“谢谢”。不管他喜不喜欢，如果他连一根手指都不放在杯子上，那是很不礼貌的。
So next time , I'd better take a few sips , to ' save face ' at least , right ?	所以下一次，我最好喝几口，至少是为了“面子”，对吧？
Sure . The guest is welcomed by being served tea . But if after chatting for a while , the host asks servants or family members to serve a new cup of tea , or add some hot water , he is giving another signal .	当然。客人受到茶水招待。但是，聊会天之后，主人让仆人或家人端上一杯新茶，或加一些热水，他是在发出另一个信号。
What does that imply , then ?	这又意味着什么呢？
More often than not , the understatement is ' I'm afraid it's time you leave ' .	一般轻描淡写的说法是“恐怕你该走了”。

You see , the bungee participants take a deep breath when they stand at the starting spot and then , like diving , their heads are over heels and they jump off into the realm of the combination of heaven and earth The wind roars at their ears and their bodies rapidly descend . They do not even have enough time to do several gymnastic movements and they are rebounded to the upper air by the cord .	你看，蹦极选手站在起跑点深吸一口气，然后像跳水一样，头朝下脚朝上，纵身一跃融入天地合一的境界，风在耳边呼啸，身体急速下降。还没来得及做几个体操动作，就被绳子反弹到高空。
Entrusting life to the care of a rope indeed requires infinite courage .	把生命托付给一根绳子确实需要莫大的勇气。
A young French fellow recalled his first bungee experience and said , When I fastened the cord and walked to the platform , I was extremely nervous . When I looked down , I was nervous even more.If the cord had broken , I would be knocked to bake meat . However , I knew my worries were unwanted . I was afraid if I retreated others might say something about me . I had to harden my heart and impose my head downward . I only felt wind wiring at my ears . My body rapidly descended . I thought that after only seven or eight seconds I was rebounded to upper air by the cord . In fact it was 30 seconds . Maybe because of my nervousness , I only felt seven or eight seconds . When rebounding to the high altitude , I felt a sudden sense of relief . I did not feel nervous very much , but very comfortable .	一个法国小伙子回忆起他第一次蹦极的经历，他说，当我系好绳子走向跳台时，我非常紧张。我往下看的时候更紧张，如果绳子断了，我就完蛋了。但我知道我的担心是多余的。我怕自己退后别人会说我。所以只能一狠心，把头向下压。我只觉得耳边有风。我的身体迅速下降。我以为只过了七八秒我就被绳子弹到了高空。其实是30秒。可能是因为紧张，我只感觉到七八秒钟。当反弹到高空时，我突然有一种解脱的感觉。我不觉得紧张，反而很舒服。

A Westerner said to his Chinese friend . “ Chinese people slurp when drinking soup . It ’ s disgusting . ” The Chinese friend replied , “ Westerners make a lot of noise licking their fingers when eating . It ’ s even worse . ”	一个西方人对他的中国朋友说：“中国人喝汤的时候会发出声音，真恶心。”他的中国朋友回应道：“西方人吃饭时舔手指发出的声音，更恶心。”
Everyone has his own habits , but these habits are not very good . The noise often spoils other people ’ s appetite .	每个人都有自己的习惯，但这些习惯并不好。这些噪音总是会破坏别人的食欲。
I attended a course on table manners while I was in the United States . Some of the things we learnt included how to place the napkin and utensils and how to pass the bread . Before each course , the teacher would ask if we wanted to learn the Continental European way or the American way . We always said “ American way . ” It ’ s amazing that everyone is so used to their own table manners . What is the Chinese way ?	我在美国的时候参加了一个关于餐桌礼仪的课程。学到了一些关于怎么摆放餐巾和餐具，以及怎么传面包。在每节课前，老师都会问我们是想学欧洲还是美洲的方式。我们总是选择美式。但令人惊讶的是，每个人都习惯了他们自己的餐桌礼仪。中国的方式是什么呢？
The westerners use knives and forks to eat so it is complicated . The Chinese use a pair of chopsticks and eat out of the same plate . I assume it is less complicated , right ?	西方人用刀叉吃饭，所以很复杂。中国人用筷子和盘子吃饭。我觉得相对没有那么复杂。
Not really . I did some research about Chinese table manners . The important rule is to remain silent while eating . Of course , this refers to family meals only . Not talking over meals is supposed to be good for the health . It is impolite if people do not talk to each other during a social party . The table arrangements and serving order for a social party are equally complicated . Each dish should be placed in the correct position . When fish is served , the tail should be pointing at the guest because tail meat is supposed to be tasty . If it is in winter , the stomach should face the right-hand side of the guest because that portion of the fish is very rich in winter . Each dish should be commenced by the eldest person who is seated at the head of the table . The diners should sit close to the table so food won ’ t drop on their cloths . No noise should be made when chewing . No one should move food back to the communal plate even if he doesn ’ t like it . One should drink soup slowly and is not supposed to make a lot of noise . All these table manners are very similar to Western habits .	也不是。我做了一些关于中国餐桌礼仪的调查。最重要的是，在吃饭的时候保持沉默。当然了，只是指家庭聚餐的时候。吃饭的时候不说话，对健康也是有好处的。但在社交聚会上，人们不跟对方说话也是不礼貌的。餐桌的安排和上菜的顺序也都很复杂。每道菜都要在正确的位置上。当鱼上来的时候，鱼尾应该冲着客人，因为大家认为鱼尾是最好吃的。如果是在冬天，鱼中间的部分应该朝着客人的右手边，因为在冬天，那一部分是很肥美的。每道菜都会由坐在上位的年长的人先吃。吃饭的人应该坐的离桌子近一些，以防食物掉到衣服上。嚼东西的时候不应该发出声音。也不能把食物再放回公盘里，即使不喜欢那道菜。应该慢慢喝汤，并且不要发出声音。所有的餐桌礼仪其实跟西方很相似。
It seems that people share the same basic sense of etiquette regardless of their background . Apart from the different tools used for eating we seem to follow the same principles . We do not let inappropriate manners spoil other people ’ s appetite.Westerners like to say , “ bon appetite ” before meals which is one way to suggest “ mind your table manners . ” Is there such an expression in Chinese ?	好像不管什么背景，人们对礼仪的看法都基本相同。除了吃饭用的工具不同，其他好像都基本一样。西方人喜欢在饭前说“希望今天胃口不错“，来表达”要注意餐桌礼仪“。汉语的表达里有类似的吗？
Yes . We say “ eat well and drink well . ”	是的，我们会说”要吃好和好啊“。

Welcome to our show ! Today , I am going to show you how to make the perfect mouthwatering sandwich ! Are you ready ? Let ’ s get started !	欢迎来到我们的节目！今天，我要向你展示如何做一个完美的令人垂涎欲滴的三明治！你准备好了吗？我们开始吧！
Let ’ s start with the basics , bread . Bread is an important ingredient here . You need to remember one thing - choose the bread according to the following criteria , freshness , crumb and color . If you want a closed sandwich I recommend you first toast your bread in a toaster or oven , or grill it slightly until it gets a light brown color .	让我们从最基本的开始，面包。面包是这里的重要配料。你需要记住一件事-选择面包根据以下标准，新鲜度，面包屑和颜色。如果你想要一个封闭的三明治，我建议你首先在烤面包机或烤箱里烤面包，或者稍微烤一下直到它变成浅棕色。
Now that our bread is ready , let ’ s talk about the ingredients ! Of course , each person ’ s palate is different , but I ’ m going to give you a few tips that you ’ ll be able to use when turning any sandwich into the perfect sandwich . I would strongly recommend you put fresh vegetables in your sandwich .	既然我们的面包做好了，我们就来谈谈配料吧！当然，每个人的口味都不一样，但我要给你一些提示，这些提示可以把任何普通三明治都变成完美的三明治。我强烈建议你在三明治里放些新鲜蔬菜。
Do not undervalue them as they play a big role in forming the taste and will make the sandwich more refreshing and light . The best choices here are evident — cucumbers , tomatoes , onions , sweet pepper or chilli , lettuce and , of course , herbs — you can ’ t go wrong with them . As for aubergines , mushrooms and asparagus , I would recommend you first grill them slightly with a little touch of olive oil .	不要低估它们的价值，因为它们在形成口味方面起着很大的作用，会使三明治更加清爽清淡。这里最好的选择是显而易见的——黄瓜、西红柿、洋葱、甜椒或辣椒、莴苣，当然还有草药——这些选择不会错的。至于茄子、蘑菇和芦笋，我建议你先用少许橄榄油稍微烤一下。
Last but not least , we have a wide variety of condiments that we can add to our perfect sandwich . We can be subtle and just add a touch of salt and pepper , or we can combine mustard sauce , mayonnaise , ketchup or even caviar to achieve a stronger flavor ! It ’ s always a good idea to cut your sandwich in triangles or manageable pieces to avoid all your ingredients falling out and staining your shirt !	最后，我们有各种各样的调味品可以添加到我们的完美三明治中。我们可以只是添加一抹盐和胡椒，或者我们可以结合芥末酱，蛋黄酱，番茄酱，甚至鱼子酱，以实现更强烈的味道！把三明治切成三角形或易于管理的小块是个好主意，这样可以避免所有的配料掉出来弄脏你的衬衫！
That ’ s all the time we have for today , but join us next time where we ’ ll be going over how to make the perfect lasagna ! Till next time !	我们今天就说这么多，但下次请加入我们，我们将讨论如何制作完美的千层面！直到下次！

Cardiopulmonary resuscitation !	心肺复苏！
That ’ s right ! We apply CPR in the case of cardiac arrest or pulmonary arrest .	没错！我们在心脏骤停或肺骤停的情况下应用心肺复苏术。
What does that mean ?	是什么意思？
Well , basically if your heart stops pumping blood , or your lungs stop pumping air , then we need to get them going again ! That ’ s when we have to apply this procedure . Let ’ s begin ! I need a volunteer .	嗯，简单来说，如果你的心脏停止供血，或者你的肺停止供气，那么我们需要让它们重新开始工作！那时候我们必须采用这个程序。我们开始吧！我需要一个志愿者。
Me ! Me !	我！我！
Alright , come here and lay flat on your back . Let ’ s suppose this young woman has stopped breathing . We must lift the person ’ s chin so that we clear a pathway for air to get into the lungs . What ’ s the difference ?	有什么区别？
Well , standard mail can take up to fifteen working days . Priority is a bit faster and will arrive in about five to eight working days . Express is the fastest , but it ’ s also the most expensive . It only takes three days and you can track your package online .	标准邮件可能需要15个工作日。优先要快一点，大约在5到8个工作日内到达。特快邮件是最快的，但也是最贵的。只需要三天，你就可以在线跟踪你的包裹。

You should go to the library to find some information about American universities , and write to the Admission Office . First of all , you need official transcripts of your undergraduate work , three letters of recommendation from your professors who know your competence , and the official TOEFL ( Test of English as a Foreign Language ) score ( It ’ s usually 550 ) . Then you need a financial guarantee , and an application fee of 25 dollars .	这是真的。我可以为你列出大部分大学的要求。首先，你需要正式的本科成绩单，三封了解你能力的教授写的推荐信，以及托福成绩（通常是550分）。之后你需要提供经济担保，交25美元的申请费。

Ms.Green , are the schools more or less similar everywhere throughout the United States , or do they differ in various sections ?	格林女士，美国各地的学校都差不多，还是不同地区的学校不同？
The system of public schools is fairly uniform everywhere throughout the United States .	美国各地的公立学校体系相当一致。
Do most students in the United States attend private schools or public schools ?	美国大多数学生是上私立学校还是公立学校？
Most public schools in the United States are very good , and the majority of students attend the public schools .	美国大多数公立学校都很好，大多数学生都上公立学校。
Which students go to private schools , then ?	那么，哪些学生上私立学校呢？
Children needing special instruction . Children whose parents can afford to send them to private schools , and children whose parents want them to receive a religious education .	需要特殊教育的孩子。父母能负担私立学校费用的孩子，以及父母希望他们接受宗教教育的孩子。
But are the public schools good everywhere ?	但是，公立学校只有好处吗？
No , public schools can be very different . Even in the same city .	不，公立学校会有很大的不同。即使在同一个城市。
Dose it cost anything to attend the public schools ? Are there any restrictions as to who may and may not attend ?	上公立学校要花钱吗？关于什么样的学生不能上有什么限制吗？
The public schools in the United States are free to everyone and there is no cost to the student . In most states , even the textbooks are free . There are no restrictions as to color , race , or religion.Any student wishing to attend the public schools may do so .	美国的公立学校对每个人都是免费的，对学生来说没有任何费用。在大多数州，甚至教科书都是免费的。在肤色、种族或宗教方面没有任何限制。任何想上公立学校的学生都可以上。

Can you give us an example ?	你能给我们举个例子吗？
I'll look up the rate . To look up doesn't mean to look high into the sky or to look at the roof . It means to search for and find some information .	我查一下费率。这里的仰望并不意味着仰望天空或屋顶。它意味着搜索和发现一些信息。
What about the expression " goodbye " ? Is that an idiom ?	“再见”这个词怎么样？这是成语吗？
That is just a natural , grammatical English expression . It has a direct translation in other languages .	那只是一个自然的、合乎语法的英语表达。它在其他语言中有直译版本。

In the nineteenth century , working conditions were appalling , with workers being forced to work ten , twelve , and fourteen hours a day . Support for the eight-hour work day movement was growing rapidly , despite the indifference and hostility of many union leaders , and by April 1886 , 250,000 workers were involved in the May Day movement.Previous legislative attempts to improve working conditions had failed , so labor organizers took drastic measures . They passed a resolution stating that eight hours would constitute a legal day ’ s work . And , on May First 1886 , the resolution took effect .	在十九世纪，工作条件非常恶劣，工人们被迫每天工作十、十二、十四个小时。尽管许多工会领袖对此漠不关心，怀有敌意，但对“八小时工作日”运动的支持却在迅速增长，到1886年4月，已有25万工人参与了“五一”运动，此前曾尝试通过立法改善工作条件，但都失败了，因此劳工组织者采取了严厉措施。他们通过了一项决议，规定一天固定工作8小时。1886年5月1日，决议生效。
Cool ! Is that why we only work eight hours now ?	酷！这就是为什么我们现在只工作八小时？
Yes ! But the happy ending came at a high price.On May third , 1886 , police fired into a crowd of strikers at the McCormick Reaper Works Factory , killing four and wounding many . A mass meeting was called for the next day to protest the brutality .	对！1886年5月3日，警察向麦考密克收割机工厂的罢工人群开枪，打死4人，打伤多人。第二天就召开群众大会，抗议这种暴行。

Are the galaxies in the universe moving through space ?	宇宙中的星系在太空中运动吗？
No , the galaxies sit more or less passively in the space around them . But not too much . As the space between galaxies expands , it carries the galaxies further apart - like raisins in an expanding dough .	不，星系或多或少被动地坐落在它所在的空间里。但不是所有。当星系间的空间膨胀时，它会把星系分离地更远——就像膨胀面团中的葡萄干。
But I heard that our Milky way galaxy may one day collide with a neighboring galaxy . If galaxies are moving apart from each other , how can they collide ?	但我听说我们的银河系有朝一日可能会与邻近的星系相撞。如果星系彼此分离，它们怎么会碰撞？
Well , the universe is a chaotic place , and the gravity from one galaxy , or from a group of galaxies , may disturb the motion of its near neighbors , causing them to collide . However , on average , when you compare two large enough chunks of space , the galaxies in one are moving away from the galaxies in the other .	嗯，宇宙是一个混乱的地方，来自一个星系或一组星系的引力，可能会干扰其邻近星系的运动，导致它们相撞。然而，平均而言，当你比较两个足够大的星系空间块时，它们其实在不断远离。

Well , Mike , nowadays there's much talk about nanometer . But what on earth is it ?	嗯，迈克，现在有到处都在讨论纳米。但纳米到底是什么？
Nanometer is a length scale . It's one billionth of a meter , roughly ten times the size of an individual atom .	纳米是长度刻度。它是十亿分之一米，大约是单个原子大小的十倍。
Hmm ... it's hard to figure out the exact size , I'm afraid .	额...恐怕很难计算出确切的长度。
Well , let's make it this way . For comparison , 10 NM is 1000 times smaller than the diameter of a human hair . There are as many nanometers in an inch as there are inches in 400 miles .	好吧，就这样吧。相比之下，10纳米比人类头发的直径小1000倍。一英寸里的纳米数等于400英里里的英寸数。

It's a scam 7 that's based on a hierarchy , like a pyramid . The person at the top asks the people below him for money , and then tells them to go and ask other people for money while sending some of it back to him .	这是一个基于等级制度的骗局，就像金字塔一样。上线向下线要钱，然后告诉他们去向别人要钱，同时还一些钱给他。

Not exactly . The scam keeps on going , with the people at the bottom paying more and more money until they reach the very bottom .	不完全是这样。骗局还在继续，底层的人付出越来越多的钱，直到他们成为最底层。

How can a business maximise revenues ?	企业如何才能最大限度地提高收入？
You need to invest in some good advertising . You have to know where your potential customers are and target them . It ’ s no good trying to sell computer games to older people . The market is too small .	你需要投资一些好的广告。你必须知道你的潜在客户在哪里，并瞄准他们。把电脑游戏卖给老年人是没有用的。市场太小了。
What else do you suggest ?	你还有什么建议？
Find out what other companies charge for the same products or services . Price yourself near the low end . No , it isn ’ t . it ’ s a pity , because I ’ d like to see it in action .	没有。很遗憾，因为我想看看它的实际效果。

They showed flowers that only provide their nectar to one type of butterfly or bee . The insect has to be the exact size to get the nectar . Other insects cannot get it . Of course , when the insect collects the nectar , it also takes some pollen from one flower to another .	他们还展示一些只为一种蝴蝶或蜜蜂提供花蜜的花。昆虫必须有准确的大小才能得到花蜜。其他昆虫就无法获得花蜜。当然，当昆虫收集花蜜时，它也会把一些花粉从一朵花带到另一朵花上。

What ’ s the difference between football and rugby ?	足球和橄榄球有什么区别？
Those tow games are quite different . First , there ’ s the size of the teams . In football , a team has 11 players . In rugby there are 15 players on each team . The biggest difference is that in football , only the goalkeeper can use his hands . In rugby , the ball is usually carried forward by players , though kicking is permitted .	是两个完全不同的运动。首先，队伍的规模不同。在足球比赛的每一对有11名队员。橄榄球比赛有15名队员。最大的区别是在足球中，只有守门员才能用手。在橄榄球比赛中，运动员基本都是用手，当然踢是允许的。
In rugby , players pass the ball by throwing it to team mates , don ’ t they ?	在橄榄球比赛中，运动员通过把球扔给队友来传球，是吗？
That ’ s right . However , players can only pass the ball backwards . They cannot pass the ball forwards to their team mates . That ’ s a foul .	没错。然而，球员只能向后传球。他们不能把球传给队友。那是犯规。
I know how goals are scored in football , but how about in rugby ?	我知道足球是怎么进球的，但橄榄球呢？
If a team carries the ball over the goal line , they score points . A team can also score points by kicking the ball between two tall posts at each end of the pitch .	如果一支球队带球越过球门线，他们就得分。也可以把球踢入球场两端的两个高柱之间得分。
There ’ s a lot more physical contact in rugby , isn ’ t there ?	橄榄球运动中的身体接触要多得多，对吗？
Yes . Players usually need to bring a player down to stop him from moving forward with the ball . This is called ” tackling ” , as in football .	对。球员们通常需要把一个球员拉下来以阻止他带球移动。这被称为“拦截”，就像在足球中一样。
The ball is a different shape in rugby , isn ’ t it ?	橄榄球的形状不同，对吗？
Yes . It ’ s not perfectly round like a football . A rugby ball is oval in shape . There ’ s a match on TV this afternoon . Why don ’ t you watch it with me ? I ’ ll try to explain the rules and tactics while we ’ re watching .	对。它不像足球那么圆。橄榄球是椭圆形的。今天下午电视上有一场比赛。你为什么不和我一起看呢？我们在看的时候，我会尽可能解释规则和战术。

What do you think are the main causes of war today ?	你认为今天战争的主要原因是什么？
I ’ d say the main reason is poverty . Countries and their people get frustrated because they have so little . If their neighbors have some resources , they try to steal them by military force .	我认为主要是因为贫穷。国家和人民就会感到沮丧，因为他们手上物资太少。如果他们的邻居有一点资源，他们就想用武力来窃取。
It seems that a lot of wars nowadays are really civil wars . People from different ethnic groups in the same country sometimes fight for power in that country .	看来现在很多战争都是内战。同一个国家的不同种族的人有时会为国家的权力而战。
Several of those civil wars have been going on for years and years . It seems they will never end .	其中几场内战已经持续了很多年。似乎永远不会结束。
How do you think they could be ended ?	你认为战争会怎样结束？
I don ’ t think that there is any easy way . The united nations could send peacekeepers into the country . At least then the warring parties could be forced to negotiate . The thing is to find the real problem form the war and solve that .	我认为没有什么简单的办法。联合国可以派遣维和人员进入该国。至少在那时，交战双方可能会被迫进行谈判。关键是要找到战争的真正问题所在并加以解决。
So , if the cause is poverty , there should be a program to make the country richer . If the problem is resources , share them .	所以，如果原因是贫困，就应该有一个让国家摆脱贫穷的计划。如果问题是资源，那就资源共享。
It sounds easy when you say it like that . In reality , it ’ s harder to make peace between countries .	你这样说听起来很容易。其实，在国家间实现和平很难。
Yes . It is . One way to stop countries fighting is to cut off their financial support . Wars are very expensive .	嗯嗯，阻止国家争斗的一个方法是切断财政支持。战争是非常昂贵的。
The problem is that many poor people might suffer .	问题是许多穷人可能会受苦。

Did you set your clock forward for daylight savings time ?	你把时钟调成夏令时了吗？
What ? Why do we have to do that ?	什么？我们为什么要这么做？
Well , at the start of the spring we usually have more daylight in the mornings and less in the afternoon . This is basically due to our position on the planet and the rotation of the earth . In any case , to take better advantage of the daylight available , we compensate by moving our clocks forward one hour .	因为在春天开始的时候，上午的白昼时间要长些，而下午的白昼时间要短些。这是受到我们在地球上的位置以及地球的自转影响。无论如何，我们要利用好白天的时间，将时钟向前拨了一个小时来补偿时间。
I see . That ’ s convenient ! I never understood things like this , such as GMT . I never know what time zone we are in or when to change my clock !	我懂了。那样做很合适！我从来就不懂像GMT这样的事情。我一直不知道我们在哪个时区，以及什么时候来往前拨一个小时！
That just stands for Greenwich Mean Time . Here in California , we are in Pacific Standard Time , that is eight time zones west of Greenwich . Remember when we were in Beijing ? Well , then we were in China Standard Time , and that ’ s eight time zones east of Greenwich !	GMT代表格林威治标准时间。加利福尼亚在太平洋标准时区，在格林威治以西的第八时区。记得我们在北京的时间吗？那时我们在中国标准时间，也就是格林威治时区以东的第八个时区！
That ’ s why it was so weird traveling from Beijing to LA ! Because of the huge time difference , even though we left Beijing at noon and flew for more than eight hours , we still arrived in LA the same day at noon ! It ’ s like we went back in time !	这就是从北京到洛杉矶旅行这么奇怪的原因！由于时差差异，虽然我们中午离开北京，飞行了8个多小时，但到达洛杉矶时仍然是同一天中午！就像我们回到了过去！

In the nineteenth century , working conditions were appalling , with workers being forced to work ten , twelve , and fourteen hours a day . Support for the eight-hour work day movement was growing rapidly , despite the indifference and hostility of many union leaders , and by April 1886 , 250,000 workers were involved in the May Day movement . Previous legislative attempts to improve working conditions had failed , so labor organizers took drastic measures . They passed a resolution stating that eight hours would constitute a legal day ’ s work . And , on May First 1886 , the resolution took effect .	在十九世纪，工作条件非常恶劣，工人们被迫每天工作十、十二、十四个小时。尽管许多工会领袖对此漠不关心，甚至怀有敌意，但越来越多人支持“八小时工作日”运动，到1886年4月，已有25万工人参与了“五一”运动。以前改善工作条件的立法尝试失败了，所以劳工组织采取了严厉的措施。他们通过了一项决议，规定一天工作八小时。1886年5月1日，决议开始生效。
Cool ! Is that why we only work eight hours now ?	酷！这就是为什么我们现在只工作八小时？
Yes ! But the happy ending came at a high price.On May third , 1886 , police fired into a crowd of strikers at the McCormick Reaper Works Factory , killing four and wounding many . A mass meeting was called for the next day to protest the brutality .	对！1886年5月3日，警察向麦考密克收割机工厂的罢工人群开枪，打死4人，打伤多人。第二天就召开群众大会，抗议这种暴行。

I can help you there . Those are numbers that cannot be created by multiplying two whole numbers , apart from the number itself and 1 , together .	我可以帮你。素数是无法用两个整数相乘得到的数字，除了数字本身和1之外。
So , 1,2 and 3 are prime numbers , but 4 isn ’ t because 2 * 2 = 4 .	所以，1，2和3是素数，但4不是，因为2*2=4。
Exactly . Anything else ?	是的。还有其他的问题吗？

Yeah . Water pollution has for a long time been a major concern among the environmental issues .	是啊。长期以来，水污染一直是人们关注的一个重大环境问题。
But what are the sources of water pollution ?	但是水污染的来源是什么呢？
They could generally be divided into two categories , direct and indirect contaminant sources .	一般可分为两类，直接污染源和间接污染源。
Well , direct ones are the pollution directly from factories , refineries waste treatment plants etc . , aren ’ t they ?	直接来源是工厂、炼油厂、废物处理厂，它们直接造成污染，不是吗？
Yeah . They are emitted directly into urban water supplies .	是的。它们直接将污染物排放到城市供水系统中。
But what about the indirect ones ?	那间接来源呢？
Indirect sources include contaminants that enter the water supply from soils or groundwater systems and from the atmosphere via rainwater .	间接来源包括土壤、地下水和大气降水，污染物通过这些途径进入供水系统。
I see . For the sake of us all , we should be an active participator in the prevention of it .	我懂了。为了集体利益，我们应该积极参与预防工作。

Since China was open to the outside world , its trade forms have become much more flexible . One of these commonly used forms is co-production . Would you please do a bit explanation of it , Mr . Walker ?	中国对外开放以来，贸易形式更加灵活。常见形式之一是合作生产。沃克先生，请您解释一下可以吗？
Well , under this arrangement two parties cooperate to manufacture a product or a category of products , for example , machine tools for export . Each party produces and supplies a part of the components and parts ; one party is a Chinese enterprise , the other , an overseas firm . Most probably , the foreign counterpart contributes technology and equipment , and sometimes , parts and components , while the Chinese enterprises factory building , labor and other resources to the cooperative production . They join hands and fulfill orders together by an agreement or a contract .	嗯，合作生产指的是双方合作生产某种产品或某类产品，例如出口机床。双方各生产和供应部分零部件；一方是中国企业，另一方是海外公司。通常情况下，外国同行提供技术和设备，有时还提供零部件，而中国企业则提供厂房、劳动力和其他资源进行合作生产。双方通过协议或合同共同完成订单。
I suppose that the assembling of these components and parts , particularly the marketing of the finished products should take place in China .	我觉得这些零部件的组装，尤其是成品的销售应该是在中国吧。
Not necessarily . It depends on the contract stipulations . They may be marketed in the foreign country where the other party is located , or even in a third country .	不一定。这要看合约的规定,他们也许在另一方的国家营销,或者也许在第三国营销。
I think the principle of co-production is to expand export trade . It's a reciprocal business , isn't it ?	我觉得联合生产的规则可以扩展到出口贸易，这是互惠互利的生意，不是吗？
Yes , you are right . Either party is not well-equipped to produce the final products single-handedly , but they can enter into an agreement . In such case , each side contributes different resources to make the manufacture of a certain product or a category of products possible .	是的，你说得对。任何一方都不具备单独生产最终产品的能力，但他们可以达成协议。因此每一方都可以提供不同的资源，这样来生产某一产品或某一类产品。

Well , the pulp falls from a box onto the first part of the paper machine , which is basically a wire bed with large holes in it , where most of the water is extracted .	好吧，盒子里的纸浆倒入造纸机的第一部分，这基本上就是一个有网眼的金属丝床，用于滤出大部分的水。
So , is it actually paper at this stage ?	那么，这时我们就能得到真正的纸？
Yes , it is . But we need to take out more water . So it then passes through a series of rollers , where more water is squeezed out . After that it goes through the dryers , which are at a very high temperature . The paper is then coated . And finally it's wound onto reels and cut down into smaller lengths .	是的。但是我们需要再次过滤。然后使用一系列的滚筒，挤出更多的水。之后，使用烘干机，机器温度非常高。接着加涂层。最后绕在卷轴上，切成短片。

Recycling is big business these days , isn't it ?	如今回收可是一个大买卖，不是吗？
Yes , it's definitely a growing business .	是的，这绝对是一个蓬勃发展的行业。
What do you recycle in your plant ?	你在工厂里都回收些什么？
Mainly plastics . Plastics aren ’ t bio degradable - they don ’ t break down easily in the environment - so they shouldn't be thrown away .	主要是塑料。塑料不能生物降解，在环境中不容易分解，因此不能随意丢弃。
How is plastic recycled , then ?	那么塑料是如何回收的呢？
Well , there are basically two methods . One is to break down the chemicals in the plastic into smaller chemical particles . These can then be used in the production of new chemicals .	基本有两种方法。一种是将塑料中的化学物质分解成更小的化学粒子，这些粒子可以用来生产新的化学品。
Is that the method you use here ?	这就是你们这里使用的方法吗？
No , we don't do that here . We recycle polyethylene and we make it into other products .	不，我们这里不用这种方法。我们回收聚乙烯并把它制成其他产品。

Would you please explain for me what a business contract implies ?	请你给我解释一下商业合同的含义好吗？
A contract is an agreement which is binding on both parties mutually . A contract might be formal or informal , oral or written . An implemented contract is one which has been fully executed by both sides ; an executive contract is one which is going to be performed . They are enforceable by laws and any party who defaults the contract may be sued and forced to make compensation .	合同是指对双方都有约束力的协议。合同可以是正式的或者非正式的，口头的或者书面的。已履行的合同是指双方已经完全履行了的合同；执行合同是要履行的合同，具有法律效力，任何一方违约都可能会被起诉，并依法作出赔偿。
What are the purposes of contract ?	合同的目的是什么？
In an ordinary contract , the objective of a contract might be relatively simple , indicating the description of commodity , price , quantity , terms of payment and etc .	在普通合同中，合同的目的就是简单地表明商品的价格、数量、付款条件等。
When we draft a contract , which points should we pay special attention to ?	在起草合同时，我们应该特别注意哪些方面？
Well . First , make meaning clear by using concise forma language . Second , describe accurately the exact requirement . Finally , state clearly the permissible variation in quantity .	首先，要简明扼要表达意思。第二，要准确描述具体要求。最后，要明确说明可以允许的数量变化。

Could you tell me something about investment environment of your country ?	你能介绍一些有关你们国家投资环境的情况吗?
Our country is a free trade nation . She was mainly agriculture and rather a backward country and mow has developed into a modern highly industrialized state with an expanding economy . Parallel to this , her dependence upon foreign trade has increased . Increased output generates a greater need for raw materials , semi-finished products and capital goods . Thus . in many fields , our country is an important and growing market for exporters from other countries . But this doesn't mean that our country is an easy market , because of a liberal import policy and the high standard in our market is keen .	我们国家是一个自由贸易国家。她曾经农产业为主，是一个相当落后的国家，但是现在已经发展成为一个高度工业化的现代化国家，经济一直不断发展。与此同时，国家对外贸的依赖也增加了。产量增加后，对原材料、半成品和资本货物的需求也增加了。因此，在很多领域，对于其他国家的出口商来说，我们国家是一个重要的、正在逐步壮大的市场。但这并不意味着进入我国市场非常容易，国家实行的是自由化的进口政策，市场的标准要求很高。

Your definition on success ?	你对成功的定义是什么？
Most people think that wealth means success . But from my point of view , the problem should be viewed from two aspects . On the one hand , wealth is a very important thing to measure success . The ability to make money , to some extent , signifies your knowledge , your capability , the value of your labor , etc .. With the development of our economy and industry , more and more people are pursuing money these days . And in toda / s society , If you have money , you seem to have everything . But this is not the case . I think success , on the other hand , also means satisfaction from work . It also means that you can get respect from others .	大多数人认为财富意味着成功。但在我看来，这个问题应该从两个方面来看待。一方面，财富是衡量成功的一个非常重要的东西。赚钱的能力，在某种程度上意味着你的知识，你的能力，你劳动的价值等等。随着我国经济和工业的发展，越来越多的人现在追求金钱。在当代社会，如果你有钱，你似乎就拥有了一切。但事实并非如此。我认为成功另一方面也意味着从工作中得到满足。它也意味着你能从他人那里获得尊重。
What ’ s your ideal job ?	你理想的工作是什么？
Ideally , I ’ d like to have a job that will allow me to work from home several days a week . I ’ m the kind of person who can set priorities , work well independently , and set my own pace . I actually successfully worked from home for several months in my current job when a problematic pregnancy forced me to stay in bed . But I realize that many employers do not have experience with employees who work from home , and I have , of course , performed very successfully in a traditional office setting .	理想情况下，我希望有一份能让我一周有几天在家工作的工作。我是那种能分清轻重缓急，独立工作能力强，并能自己定步调的人。事实上，在我目前的工作中，当怀孕问题迫使我卧床时，我成功地在家工作了几个月。但我意识到，许多雇主都没有在家工作的经验，当然，我在传统的办公室环境中也表现地十分出色。

What's your ideal boss ?	你理想的老板是什么？
I have had an incredible boss , who was my direct supervisor during the last year of my coop work experience . A-bout two months after I began working for her , she really let me spread my wings . She encouraged me to work independently , because she said she had come to trust my judgment and commitment . So I was able to move forward on projects without having to check in with her every day . Of course , I made certain that she knew what I had accomplished on a daily and weekly basis because I gave her summary reports , although she didn't specifically ask me to . Without her support and encouragement , I don't think I would have felt confident enough to have written up a proposal suggesting that the department change a process that had been in place for a long time . But she was open to suggestions , so long as employees could back them up with research and facts . When I submitted my suggestion , she reviewed it and told me where she thought it needed more work . She then took my revised proposal to her boss . He was a more conservative type , but she lobbied him to try It for several weeks . He did , and it was so successful that it was instituted as a permanent change . I've also worked for some very difficult bosses in summer and part-time jobs . And while I'd certainly prefer to work for one like I've just described , I'm the kind of person who can get along with just about anyone .	我有一个令人难以置信的老板，他是我在合作社工作的最后一年的直接主管。大约在我开始为她工作两个月后，她真的让我大开眼界。她鼓励我独立工作，因为她说她开始相信我的判断和承诺。我可以把项目向前推进，不必每天和她联系。当然，我确保她知道我每天和每周干了什么，我会给她总结报告，尽管她没有特别要求我这么做。如果没有她的支持和鼓励，我想我不会有足够的信心起草建议，希望新闻部改变一个已经实施了很长时间的程序。但她愿意接受建议，只要建议有研究和事实支持。当我提交我的建议后，她进行了审阅，并告诉我她认为哪里需要改善。然后，她把我修改过的建议告诉了她的老板。他比较保守，但她说服他尝试了几个星期。他做到了，非常成功，我的建议成为了一项制度。我也曾在暑期和兼职中为一些非常难相处的老板工作过。虽然我当然更愿意为我刚才描述的这类人工作，但我是那种几乎可以和任何人相处的人。

China is now a member of world trade organization . Is it fair to China , do you think ?	中国现在是世界贸易组织的成员。作为WTO的一员，中国将得在经济政策上做出一点改变，以便能够遵循其他WTO成员的惯例。你认为这对中国公平吗？
It's a hard question , but I'm sure the reexamination of China's economic policies in the past may lead us to a right answer to the question . After the establishment of new China , our government employed numerous economics policies to stimulate the growth of China's economy . These policies , however , favored our domestic enterprises and protected them from international competition and these policies have contributed a lot to the rapid growth of both China economy and our domestic enterprises . After China's entry into TO , Chinese domestic enterprises will have to compete with their foreign counterparts . This new situation entails some changes of Chinese economic policies . These changes will spur Chinese enterprises to strengthen their competitiveness in the long run .	这是一个很难回答的问题，但我相信，重新审视中国过去的经济政策，可能会让我们找到正确的答案。新中国成立后，我国政府采取了许多经济政策来刺激中国经济的增长。然而，这点政策有利于我国企业，保护它们不受国际竞争的影响，对我国经济和国内企业的快速发展作出了巨大贡献。中国加入wto后，国内企业将需要与国外同行展开竞争。这种新形势要求中国经济政策发生一点变化。从长远来看，这点变化将促使中国企业增强竞争力。
We can infer that the non-discrimination principle is one of the most important principles of TO agreement . This principle requires equal treatment of domestic and foreign enterprise . Does the principle also apply to domestic enterprise of different ownerships ?	我们可以推断，不歧视原则是达成协议的最重要原则之一。这一原则要求对国内外企业一视同仁。这一原则是否也适用于不同所有制的国内企业？
Yes , it does . Domestic enterprises of different ownerships enjoy equal rights for the non-discrimination principle grants equal rights to enterprises , regardless of their nationality and ownership . I have found that although changes of China's economic policies are numerous , these changes are largely based on the most important economic principle ot TO agreement-non-discrimination principle . Such an understanding of principle of the changes may help us not only to have a good insight into the changes but also to foresee the tendency of the new changes of China's economic policies .	是的，不同所有制的国内企业享有平等的权利，因为不歧视原则赋予企业平等的权利，而不论其国籍和所有制。我发现，虽然中国经济政策的变化是多方面的，但这点变化很大程度上是基于最重要的经济原则，即协议不歧视原则。对这点变化规律的认识，不仅有助于我们深刻认识这点变化，而且有助于我们预见中国经济政策新变化的趋势。

What is the tariff ?	关税是什么呀？
It's a tax levy by the goveroverment on goods imported into that country .	是一国政府对进口到本国商品所征收的税。
Why does the government levy the tariff ?	为什么政府要征收关税呢？
Tariff provides the government with extra tax revenue .	关税能给政府提供额外的税收。
Anything else .	还有别的吗。
Tariff raises the price at which the goods are sold in the importing country and therefore makes them less competitive with locally produced goods .	关税提高了商品在进口国的销售价格，因此降低了它和当地商品的竞争力。

It is quite important to be a good listener in the interview .	在面试中做一个好的倾听者是很重要的。
Listening carefully can show you understand and respect the speaker .	仔细聆听可以表明你理解并尊重说话者。
It can show your good attainment as well .	它也能显示你的良好造诣。
Besides , you can pick up some helpful information from the talk .	此外，你可以从谈话中得到一些有用的信息。
First of all , you should keep proper posture and make eye contact with the speaker with a smile .	首先，你应该保持正确的姿势，微笑着与说话者进行眼神交流。
To show that you have understood what is said , you can nod or ask simple questions at the right time .	你可以在适当的时候点头或问一些简单的问题来表示你已经听懂了别人说的话。
And your statement should be clear and brief to the point .	你的陈述应该清楚扼要。
Never should you interrupt on a unfamiliar topic .	在一个不熟悉的话题上千万不要打断别人。
Sure , in order not to leave a bad impression on the interviewer .	当然，为了不给面试官留下坏印象。
Additionally , don't show any impatience to a repeated topic .	另外，不要对重复的话题表现出任何不耐烦。
Don't be absent-minded even when you are not interested in the talk .	即使你对谈话不感兴趣，也不要心不在焉。
In a word , any impolite behavior should be avoided in the listening .	总之，在听的过程中要避免任何不礼貌的行为。

We cannot avoid being asked questions in the interview . Sometimes , my mind goes blank .	我们在面试中难免被问到问题。有时候，我的脑子一片空白。

Firstly , your answer should go straight to the point , and be clear and brief .	首先，你的回答应该直截了当，而且要清楚和简短。
State your opinion or argument first , and then go on with details .	先陈述你的观点或者论点，然后再详述细节。
Never should you give an answer completely beside the point .	你永远不应该给出一个完全离题的答案。

Confirm the question if you don't catch it clearly .	如果你没听清楚，就确认这个问题。

Confronted with difficult questions in an interview , the job-hunters mostly will be at a loss about what to do .	在面试中遇到困难的问题时，求职者往往会不知所措。
Usually , you cannot prepare for these questions in advance and have to depend on your immediate performance .	通常情况下，你不能提前准备这些问题，只能看你现在的表现。
Still , there are some rules to follow .	不过，还是有一些规则需要遵守。
In this case , you should first keep calm and normal to the face .	在这种情况下，你应该首先保持冷静去面对。
Don't get nervous and freaked out .	不要紧张，不要惊慌失措。
Formulate a satisfactory answer based on your specific situation .	根据你的具体情况制定一个令人满意的答案。
There should be neither too much silence nor hasty answers	不要太沉默，也不要急于回答。
Try to show the best of yourself with decent words and manners .	尽量用得体的语言和举止展示自己最好的一面。
Don't be discouraged even when confronted with negative questions	即使面对消极的问题也不要气馁。
You should admit your weakness frankly .	你应该坦率地承认自己的弱点。
Anyway , what really matters is that you have tried your best .	不管怎样，真正重要的是你已经尽力了。
You must have confidence in yourself .	你必须对自己有信心。

Acknowledgments play a necessary part in the interview .	致谢在面试中不可或缺。
Sure . Kind acknowledgments can show one's good attainment .	是的。善意的致谢可以显示出一个人的良好素质。
We often ignore the acknowledgments in our daily life , and consider them as disposable .	我们经常忽略日常生活中的致谢，还把它看作是一次性的。
Actually , that's not true . Acknowledgments can help you leave a good impression on others , especially in the public places .	其实，这是不对的。致谢可以给别人留下好印象，尤其是在公共场合。
We should particularly pay attention to acknowledgments in the interview .	我们要特别注意面试中的致谢。
In the beginning of the interview , it is best that you make acknowledgments for the opportunity of the interview .	在面试开始时，最好先为本次面试机会表示感谢。
Don't forget to say " Thank you " when you take a seat .	坐下时别忘了说声“谢谢”。
Make acknowledgments as well when the interviewer thinks highly of your dressing , experience , or words .	面试官对你的穿着、经历或言语评价很高时，也要表示感谢。
You can win a good impression of the interviewer in this way .	这样能给面试官留下好印象。
Acknowledgments can also help the job-hunters to show their good attainment .	致谢还可以帮助求职者展示他们的良好素质。
Finally , at the end of the interview , make acknowledgments to the interviewer again .	最后，在面试结束时，再次向面试官致谢。
Smiles and kind attitudes are the basics of acknowledgments .	致谢最基本的就是要保持微笑和友善的态度。

Body language in the interview is closely related to the job-hunter's image .	面试中的肢体语言与求职者的形象密切相关。
Surely it is .	是的。
You should look the interviewer in the eye so as to show that you are carefully listening to him .	你应该直视面试官的眼睛，以表明你在认真听他说话。
You can nod or ask questions at the right time to show that you have already understood or you are quite interested in his words .	你可以在适当的时候点头或者提问，表示你已经理解了他的话，或者你对他的话很感兴趣。
When you are seated , bent forward a little with your hands crossed , to show you respect the interviewer .	坐着的时候，双手交叉，身体前倾一点，以示尊重。
Don't move from time to time . It is very impolite and will make you nervous .	不要乱动，这很不礼貌，也会让你紧张。
Proper posture can show your confidence .	正确的姿势可以显示你的自信。
The best would be you have a smile on your face in the interview to win a good impression of the interviewer .	最好的办法是你在面试时面带微笑，以赢得面试官的良好印象。
Pay attention to keeping eye contact as well .	注意保持眼神交流。
Throughout the interview you should maintain patience .	在整个面试过程中需要保持耐心。
In a word , you should keep decent manners in the interview .	总之，在面试中你应该举止得体。
Only in this way can you leave the interviewer a good impression and achieve success .	只有这样才能给面试官留下好印象并获得成功。

How does the political system work in your country ?	你们国家的政治制度是怎样运作的?
We have hundreds of constituencies and the votes in each one elect a member of parliament . Most people call them mp ’ s .	我们有数百个选区，从每个选区中投票选出一名议会成员，大多数称它为议员。
Each mp belongs to a political party , right ?	每个议员都属于一个政党，对吗？
Almost all of them do . A few are independent . That means that they do not belong to a party . If one party more than half of the mp ’ s . they form a government . That means that they choose a prime minister can cabinet members .	几乎都是这样的，少数几个是独立的，也就是不属于同一政党。如果一个政党的议员超过一半，那么该党就组成一个政府，他们选择首相和内阁成员。
What ’ s a cabinet ?	什么是内阁？
This is a small group of people-perhaps 25 mp ’ s who are usually ministers . They make all the big decision and discuss laws and policy .	这是一小群人，可能是25名议员，他们通常是部长。他们做所有重大决定，讨论法律和政策。
Can any mp make a law ?	任何议员都能制定法律吗？
Any mp can present a law to parliament . The proposed law is debated and voted on . If it is accepted , it becomes law .	任何议员都可以向议会提出一项法律提案。对提议的法律进行辩论和表决。如果它被接受，它就成为法律。

They produce manifesto . These documents which states their policies . Some people just vote for the same party every time there is an election . Votes who often change the party they vote for are called floating voters .	他们会发表宣言，向人们介绍他们的政策。在选举过程中，部分人每次投票给相同的政党，而经常更换投票对象的选民被称为“流动选民”。

Hello , Sir . What can we do for you today ?	你好，先生。我们能为您做些什么？
Hello . I've been asked to come and see about something called L / C ? What is it exactly ?	你好。有人叫我来看一个叫L/C的东西？那是什么？
L / C stands for ' letter of credit ' . This is necessary for trade between two countries . A Letter of Credit is quite literally that — a letter addressed by the buyer's bank to the seller's bank stating that they could vouch for their good customer , the buyer , and that they would pay the seller in case of the buyer's default . Nowadays , it's sometimes used for domestic trade too .	L/C是信用证，对两国贸易非常重要。信用证从字面上讲就是买方银行写给卖方银行的一封信，说明他们可以为客户，即买方提供担保，如果买方违约，他们会向卖方付款。现在也用于国内贸易。
So the other party could be across the world or just on the other side of the street !	所以对方可能在世界的另一边或者就在街对面！

What kind of document is an invoice ?	发票是什么？
It's a document from the seller to the buyer . It contains full particulars of the goods sold , such as quantity , quality , price , forwarding particulars , and terms of payment .	是卖方给买方的文件。包括所售货物的全部细节，比如数量、质量、价格、运输细节和付款条件。
How many kinds of foreign invoices are there ?	外国发票有多少种？
Four . They are Loco invoice , FOB invoice , CIF invoice and Franco invoice .	四种，有本地发票、离岸价发票、到岸价发票和法国式发票。
What does the price in different kinds of invoices include ?	各种发票的价格都是多少？
By Loco invoice , the price includes only the cost of goods at the warehouse of the seller . By FOB invoice , the price includes the cost before the cargo is delivered . By CIF invoice , the price includes all the expenses of cost freight and insurance . The price in Franco invoice includes all expenses to destination .	本地发票价格仅包括卖方仓库的货物成本。离岸价发票价格包括货物交付前的成本。到岸价发票价格包括所有运费和保险费。法国式发票价格包括到目的地的所有费用。
Oh , I see .	哦，我明白了。

During the last two years , there has been a great increase in goods stolen abroad .	在过去的两年里，在国外被盗的货物大幅度增加。
If they steal the entire package , that would be theft . So they don't do that . Generally , thieves open the case and take part of the contents out . Then fill the case so that the gross weight will be the same .	如果他们偷走了整个包裹，那就是偷窃。所以他们不会这么做。一般情况下，小偷会打开箱子，把里面的一部分拿出来。然后把箱子装满，使毛重相同。
If the goods are received in apparent good order and condition , the steamship company doesn ’ t have liability for pilferage . How do we protect ourselves ?	如果收到的货物表面完好无损，轮船公司就不承担偷窃责任。我们如何保护自己？
The insurance policy protects us .	保险单会保护我们。
Is it true that products of high value such as watches , jewels and luxury clothing items are often subject to pilferage ?	手表、珠宝和奢侈服装等高价值产品经常被盗，这是真的吗？
It's absolutely true in the United States that losses from pilferage have been limited to high valued goods . We must study more about packing .	在美国，偷窃造成的损失仅限于贵重物品，确实没错。我们必须再研究一下包装。

The last thing to be ignored at a Chinese dinner table is to keep modest .	在中国人的餐桌上，最不可忽视的是保持谦虚。
Does that suggest diners avoid speaking much ? The same is true in the West .	这是否意味着吃饭时应避免多说话？西方也是这样。
No , absolutely not ! On the contrary , you'll be considered a well-connected , sociable man , if you keep involved in the conversation all the time . But always pay attention to what you say . If the table has a senior guest , say something as upbeat and cheerful as possible . Or maybe , you may give the floor to him and keep listening as if very interested .	不，不是！恰恰相反，如果你一直参与谈话，你就会被认为是一个人脉很好、善于交际的人。但要注意你说的话。如果桌上有一位长者，尽可能说些乐观愉快的话。或者，你可以请他发言，听他讲话，要表现的很感兴趣。
You mean , keeping a low profile in the presence of the old ? That goes in like with Confucius ' preachings , right ?	你是说，在长者面前保持谦虚？这和孔子的教诲是一样的，对吧？
Correct . Show respect for the older people . Conventionally , before the meal starts , the younger members are supposed to address each one of the elderly members of the table one by one . Others are kept in waiting until the most venerable guest proclaim the beginning of the meal and takes the first bite . Toasts also go to these men first before people can toast to each other .	对的，尊重长者。按照惯例，在用餐开始前，年轻人应该向桌上的每一个长者问好。最尊贵的客人宣布开始用餐并吃第一口前，其他人要一直等待。在人们互相敬酒之前，也要先向长者敬酒。
Any other rules to observe in order to keep modest ?	想要保持谦虚，还有其他规矩要遵守吗？
Yes , plenty of them . Don't eat fast ! People usually keep their dining pace accorded with others . And all the dishes should not be eaten up completely .	是的，还有很多。别吃得太快！人们通常保持与别人一致的用餐节奏。也不要把所有的菜都吃光。

Did you set your clock forward for daylight savings time ?	你把时钟调成夏令时了吗？
What ? Why do we have to do that ?	什么？我们为什么要这么做？
Well , at the start of the spring we usually have more daylight in the mornings and less in the afternoon . This is basically due to our position on the planet and the rotation of the earth . In any case , to take better advantage of the daylight available , we compensate by moving our clocks forward one hour .	因为在春天开始的时候，上午的白昼时间要长些，而下午的白昼时间要短些。这是受到我们在地球上的位置以及地球的自转影响。无论如何，我们要利用好白天的时间，将时钟向前拨了一个小时来补偿时间。

That just stands for Greenwich Mean Time . Here in California , we are in Pacific Standard Time , that is eight time zones west of Greenwich . Remember when we were in Beijing ? Well , then we were in China Standard Time , and that ’ s eight time zones east of Greenwich !	GMT代表格林威治标准时间。加利福尼亚在太平洋标准时区，在格林威治以西的第八时区。记得我们在北京的时间吗？那时我们在中国标准时间，也就是格林威治时区以东的第八个时区！

So tell me , what's the difference between the Board of Directors , the CEO , and the stockholders ? They all seems ot be the same group of people to me ...	请问董事会,执行总裁和股东有什么区别?对我来说,他们好像就是一类人…
No , there's a definite difference . You know , the stockholders are the people who own the company ... they're the financial control system . Then there's the CEO — the chief executive officer . He's the hot shot , the main guy who is the boss . If there is only one person with absolute power in the organization , everyone knows that the power will go to their head . It's too dangerous . That's the reason for a Board of Directors . The board is made up of people who are experts in the industry . They could be related to the organization , but more commonly , they are independent and non-biased .	不是一类，区别大着呢。你知道,股东是公司的持有人……他们是财政控制系统.接下来是执行总裁，那大家都知道权利会冲昏他的头脑。这样做太危险。这就是为什么要设立董事会的原因。董事会由该企业的专家组成，他们参与组织管理，但更多时候他们是独立的，而且是不偏不倚的。
How many people are on the board of directors ?	董事会由多少人组成？
Usually not more than 15 , not less than 10 . They meet monthly , quarterly , or biannually to oversee an organization or company .
